name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench, grip barbell slightly wider than shoulder width, lower to mid-chest, press upward with control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells overhead keeping elbows at 45 degrees, lower smoothly.

name: Flat Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie flat with dumbbells at chest level, press up until arms are extended, lower under control.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Stand between cable towers, bring handles together in an arc hugging motion, squeeze chest at peak.

name: Push-up
instructions: Maintain rigid plank posture, lower chest to floor, push through palms to lockout.

name: Chest Dips
instructions: Grip parallel bars, lean forward slightly, lower body until upper arms are parallel to floor, press back up.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Feet hip-width, grip bar outside shins, keep neutral spine, drive through floor by extending hips and knees.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge at hips with flat back, pull barbell to lower ribcage pulling elbows back, lower under control.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs secured, pull wide bar down to upper chest, retract shoulder blades, return under control.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Overhand grip wider than shoulders, pull chest toward bar until chin clears bar, lower with full control.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit upright with feet on plates, pull handle to abdomen keeping spine neutral, squeeze lats and rhomboids.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and hand on bench, pull dumbbell up to hip with elbow driving high, lower fully.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Attach rope to high pulley, pull toward face with thumbs back, externally rotate shoulders at finish.

name: Overhead Barbell Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width, press barbell from clavicle straight overhead to full lockout.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit upright on supported bench, press dumbbells upward overhead until arms extend, lower to ears.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, raise arms laterally to shoulder height with slight forward angle, lower slow.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Use low pulley, raise handle across body up to shoulder level, keep tension throughout movement.

name: Reverse Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Sit facing machine pads, push handles backward using rear deltoids and upper back, control return.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar rested across upper traps, descent until thighs reach parallel, drive upward through mid-foot.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Clean grip resting bar on front deltoids, keep torso upright, squat deep and drive up through heels.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Place feet hip-width on sled, lower platform until knees reach 90 degrees, press without locking knees.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell vertically against chest, squat deep keeping chest proud, push floor away to stand.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge, back knee nearly touching floor, step through into next repetition.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit in machine with pad over lower shins, extend legs until straight, squeeze quads, lower slowly.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Slight knee bend, push hips backward lowering bar along shins until hamstring stretch, drive hips forward.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie facedown with pad behind ankles, curl heels toward glutes, squeeze at top, lower with control.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back against bench, pad over hips, drive hips up to full lockout squeezing glutes, lower under control.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench, lower front thigh parallel to floor, drive through front heel.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Supinated grip, keep elbows pinned to sides, curl barbell up to shoulders, lower with full extension.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit on incline bench, let arms hang, curl dumbbells while supinating wrists, slow eccentric.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Neutral grip with palms facing each other, curl dumbbells upward, emphasizing brachioradialis.

name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
instructions: Grip rope attachment, keep elbows at sides, push down and flare rope outward at lockout.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie flat holding EZ-bar above shoulders, bend elbows lowering bar to forehead, extend triceps back up.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, lower bar to sternum keeping elbows close to torso, press up to lockout.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar, raise toes toward bar without swinging, lower slowly with core tension.
